title: 第一卷 第1章 老子都穿越了，谁还当牛马啊
slug: 纨绔世子爷公主退婚我造反
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

大雍，京城，烟柳巷。

三百禁军把整条街围得跟铁桶似的。

围观的老百姓乌泱泱挤了一大片，一个个伸长了脖子，比看杀头还积极。

“嚯，这阵仗，谁犯事儿了？”

“你不知道？宁王半个月前在北境战场上失踪了，生死不明。结果他那位世子爷倒好，不着急就算了，天天泡在醉红楼里搂着姑娘喝花酒！”

“啧啧啧，关键这位爷还跟晋阳公主有婚约呢，这不是把皇家的脸按在地上摩擦了吗？”

“我看陛下这回是真要收拾他了……”

人群叽叽喳喳，所有人的目光都盯着醉红楼二楼那扇半开的窗户。

窗户里头，琵琶响着，熏香飘着。

宁王世子陈炎，此刻正一脸享受地躺在一张软榻上。

他的左边一个美人弹琵琶，右边一个姑娘剥葡萄。

正前方还有一个跳舞的，腰肢一扭一扭，看得人血压飙升。

而陈炎的嘴里叼着一颗葡萄，嘴里发出一声从灵魂深处冒出来的感叹。

“操！这他妈的才是男人该过的日子啊！”

他眯着眼，心里是无比的感慨。

上辈子他也叫陈炎。

是一个标标准准的九九六牛马。

三个月之前，他正对着电脑改第十七版方案时，突然眼前一黑，一头栽在了键盘上。

再睁眼后，他就穿到这个叫大雍的朝代，还成了宁王世子。

而原身的亲爹宁王陈霸先，不但是大雍唯一的异姓王，手底下还握着三十万边军。

虽说这个便宜老爹他连面都没见过吧。

但人家留下的家底，是真金白银地躺在那儿等他花。

京城最好的宅子，住着。

京城最贵的青楼，泡着。

京城最牛的身份，顶着。

搁上辈子，他连个年假都请不下来。

这辈子？

他特么天天都是年假。

这时，老鸨子踩着碎步噔噔噔地冲上楼来，跑得簪子都歪了。

“我的祖宗哎，宫里来人了，来传旨的！让您赶紧下去接旨！”

陈炎眼睛唰地一亮，腾地坐了起来。

老爹失踪半个月，下落不明，朝廷肯定是要让他继承王位了。

醉红楼外。

传旨太监苏培盛站在大门口，双手捧着明黄圣旨，一张老脸都快皱成核桃了。

“怎么还不出来？”

旁边，几个穿着锦衣华服的公子哥一个个兴奋得跟过年似的，眼珠子都在放光。

打头那个身材高挑的年轻人叫周元，京城永宁侯府的小公爷。

周元激动的说道：“苏公公您别急，我们这就进去把他薅出来。”

就在这时，陈炎慢悠悠地从醉红楼大门走了出来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Dayong, Beijing, Yanliu Lane.

Three hundred forbidden troops surrounded the entire street like an iron barrel.

The onlookers crowded into a large crowd, stretching their necks one by one, more enthusiastic than watching the beheading.

"Hey, who did something wrong in this battle?"

"You don't know? Prince Ning disappeared on the battlefield in the north half a month ago, and his life and death are unknown. It turns out that his prince is not in a hurry, so he just spends his days in the drunk red building holding the girl in his arms and drinking flower wine!"

"Tsk, tsk, tsk, the key point is that this gentleman is still engaged to Princess Jinyang. Isn't this just pressing the royal face to the ground and rubbing it?"

"I think His Majesty is really going to deal with him this time..."

The crowd was chattering, and everyone's eyes were fixed on the half-open window on the second floor of Zuihong Building.

Inside the window, the pipa played and incense floated.

Prince Ning's eldest son, Chen Yan, was lying on a soft couch with a look of enjoyment on his face.

To his left is a beauty playing the pipa, and to his right is a girl peeling grapes.

There was another dancer right in front of her, twisting and turning her waist, which made people's blood pressure soar.

Chen Yan held a grape in his mouth and let out a sigh that came from the depths of his soul.

"Fuck! This is the fucking life a man should live!"

He squinted his eyes, feeling extremely emotional.

In his previous life, his name was also Chen Yan.

It is a standard 996 cow and horse.

Three months ago, when he was revising the seventeenth version of the plan in front of the computer, his vision suddenly went dark and he fell headlong on the keyboard.

After opening his eyes again, he traveled to this dynasty called Dayong and became the crown prince of Prince Ning.

And the original biological father, Prince Ning, Chen Baxian, was not only the only king with a different surname in Dayong, but also had 300,000 border troops under his command.

Although he has never even met this cheap old man.

But the wealth he left behind was real money lying there waiting for him to spend.

Live in the best house in the capital.

The most expensive brothel in the capital, bathing.

The most awesome person in the capital.

For the rest of his life, he would not even be able to take an annual leave.

This life?

He has annual leave every day.

At this time, the old madam rushed upstairs with a thumping step, running so hard that the hairpin was crooked.

"My ancestor, someone is coming from the palace to deliver the order! I want you to go down quickly to receive the order!"

Chen Yan's eyes lit up and he sat up.

My father has been missing for half a month and his whereabouts are unknown. The court must let him inherit the throne.

Drunk outside the red building.

Su Peisheng, the eunuch who delivered the edict, stood at the gate, holding the bright yellow imperial edict in both hands, his old face almost wrinkled into a walnut.

"Why don't you come out?"

Next to them, several young men in brocade clothes were as excited as if they were celebrating the New Year, and their eyes were shining.

The tall young man at the head is Zhou Yuan, the young prince of Yongninghou Mansion in the capital.

Zhou Yuan said excitedly: "Eunuch Su, don't worry, we will go in and get him out right now."

At this moment, Chen Yan slowly walked out of the gate of Zuihong Mansion.
